title: Tech Lead - Connector Framework
description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. About the Role Veeam is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join the Connectors team within our Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) platform.     The Connectors team builds the integrations that power data discovery across cloud providers, SaaS applications, identity platforms, collaboration tools, and enterprise data repositories. These integrations help customers discover sensitive data, understand risk, and strengthen their security posture across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.     In this role, you will design and build scalable, cloud-native services and integrations with leading technology platforms. You will help evolve a reusable connector framework that accelerates the onboarding of new data sources to deliver customer-focused capabilities.     If you enjoy solving complex distributed systems challenges, building integrations at scale, and delivering high-quality software in a fast-paced environment, this role offers the opportunity to make a direct impact on Veeam’s DSPM platform.   What You’ll Do Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs that power Veeam’s DSPM connector ecosystem.   Develop and support integrations with cloud providers, SaaS applications, identity systems, collaboration platforms, and enterprise services.   Build reliable, efficient pipelines for data ingestion, synchronization, and metadata processing.   Own features and connector implementations across the full development lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment and production support.   Partner with Product Management, Security, and Engineering to define requirements and deliver customer-focused solutions.   Contribute to architecture and design decisions that shape the evolution of the connector platform.   Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code using sound engineering practices and AI-assisted software development lifecycle (AI-SDLC) practices.   Troubleshoot complex production issues and improve system reliability, performance, and scalability.   Enhance the connector framework and developer workflows to improve productivity and accelerate the onboarding of new integrations.   Mentor junior engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and collaborative problem-solving.   What You’ll Bring Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.   5+ years of experience building and operating backend software systems in production.   Strong programming skills in Go, C++, Java, or a comparable backend programming language.   Experience designing and developing scalable APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.   Hands-on experience with public cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.   Solid understanding of software design principles, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design.   Experience working with relational databases, NoSQL databases, or both.   Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.   Bonus Skills Experience building data connectors, integrations, or ingestion pipelines using technologies such as REST, gRPC, or Kafka.   Experience developing cloud security, data governance, or data protection products, including SIEM, DSPM, CSPM, CNAPP, or IAM solutions.   Experience building large-scale platforms for metadata collection, data discovery, synchronization, or analytics.   Proficiency with AI coding assistants such as Claude.     What you'll get Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global title: Legal, Product & Security
description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products. THE ROLE We're hiring an attorney to be the day-to-day legal partner to the teams building and securing our platform. You'll sit with Product and Engineering from design through launch, and you'll counsel Security, Compliance, Capacity, and the product and engineering teams on security including how what we commit to customers and how security and resilience run through our compute and infrastructure supply chain. At Baseten, commercial and product are nearly one and the same. What we sell is inference: compute, orchestration, deployment, and optimization delivered as the production backbone for our customers' products. That means the security of the platform is the product. Our customers run their most sensitive workloads on us, and the questions Product, Engineering, and Security bring to Legal are commercial questions and engineering questions at the same time. This is a role for a product lawyer who is fluent in security and wants to sit at that intersection. Your center of gravity is product counseling and security. Like everyone on this team, you'll also flex onto other work where you're needed. RESPONSIBILITIES - Serve as the legal partner to Product and Engineering throughout the product lifecycle. You will join planning and design reviews, spot legal risk in new features and architecture changes (data flows, access controls, model and agent capabilities), and give real-time, practical guidance teams can act on - Draft and maintain product-facing terms and policies, including security terms, documentation disclosures, and the shared-responsibility model, and keep them consistent with how the product actually works - Serve as legal lead on security incidents to establish privilege, counsel Security and forensic partners, assess customer, contractual, and regulatory notification obligations, draft customer and regulator communications, and run post-incident reviews that turn lessons into controls - Own Baseten's security positions in customer paper (security addenda, exhibits, incident-notification, vulnerability-remediation, penetration-testing, and audit-rights), partner with Commercial on negotiating them, and align with Security and GRC on what we can and cannot commit to - Partner with Security and GRC on customer assurance including security questionnaires, customer and auditor reviews, Trust Center content, and the accuracy of security claims in sales and marketing materials - Partner with Capacity and Security on security and resilience across the compute supply chain including security and incident flow-downs to compute providers and colocation partners, supply-chain and third-party risk, and the export-control touchpoints owned by AI, Privacy & Governance - Support the certifications and controls program (SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, 27701, 42001, HIPAA-eligible configurations) with Security and Compliance, and advise on risk-acceptance decisions - Build playbooks, templates, incident runbooks, and tabletop exercises, and train Product, Engineering, and Security so that standard questions self-serve and novel ones reach Legal early - Stay current on AI, security, and privacy developments (EU AI Act, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, DORA, U.S. state laws, and emerging AI-security guidance) and translate them into product requirements and recommended changes to our positions - Pitch in on customer and partnership deals, M&A, and other strategic or one-off work as needed, and help us scale the team REQUIREMENTS - JD and active bar membership in good standing - 7+ years of legal experience, including in-house product counseling at an AI-native, B2B SaaS, cloud, or developer-infrastructure company - Demonstrated product-counsel instinct. You've advised a technical product or engineering org through the development lifecycle, not just papered deals, and can hold your own in a conversation about how the product works - Meaningful security experience in at least one of: security incident response and breach notification, negotiating security terms in enterprise agreements, or security and assurance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF / SP 800-53, FedRAMP) - Working knowledge of privacy regimes (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA) as they surface in product design and security commitments - Technical fluency. An EM Technical Support Engineer serves as a trusted technical resource for Veeam’s customers, combining in-depth technical investigation, clear communication, and end-to-end case ownership to diagnose and resolve issues across applications, databases, operating systems, virtualization platforms, and networks. This is a full-time, in-office role that encourages close collaboration with Support colleagues, senior engineers, and product teams to resolve challenging technical issues, share knowledge, and continuously develop technical expertise.
